attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Shandong report identifies Linzi District Real Estate Registration Center and states that Zibo's 以图查房 service combines cadastral-map browsing with registration-information querying. It exposes no public parcel-vector URL, schema, CRS, or safe ID-plus-geometry response.

Official Zibo material confirms Linzi District Natural Resources Bureau responsibility for rural property registration records and cadastral-survey administration; it is a procedure document, not an open parcel API. No owner or title data was requested or retained.

Official Zibo portal loaded anonymously. Its public links exposed Tian地图·山东, a standard-map service, and a land-secondary-market application, but no directly linked anonymous cadastral parcel-vector endpoint.

Public land-secondary-market application loaded and its JavaScript exposed land-supply/search routes only; these are land-market records, not a qualified citywide cadastral parcel service. No unsafe fields were requested.

Anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds to the official portal link labelled 测绘成果服务系统 (surveying and mapping results service). No content, viewer configuration, endpoint, geometry, or absence inference was made; no TLS exception or bypass was used.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: No current public cadastral viewer configuration was retrieved. The Zibo home page exposed the map-to-property service only through official prose and did not expose a parcel layer URL.
